_comment: CNC Preprocessor — Mecal machine configuration. Edit tool numbers and offsets to match your machine setup.

_comment_offsets: These are GLOBAL defaults. Each value can be overridden per-WSide in profiles.json
depth_offset:        added to WDepth to produce PositionZ (face Z reference offset). Default: 5.
hole_par1_offset:    added to WHeight to give STD_HOLE PAR1 (starting Z-point). Default: -5.
slot_par1_offset:    added to WDepth (result negated) to give STD_SLOT PAR1. Default: 2.
e.g. WDepth=9 with slot_par1_offset=0 gives PAR1=-(9+0)=-9.
pocket_par1_offset:  added to WHeight to give STD_POCKET PAR1. Default: 1.
The result is optionally negated per-WSide via
legacy behaviour matches profile 1133's reference output).
mecal._comment_tools: Tool number (T register) sent with each macro. Must match tool slots loaded on your machine.
mecal._comment_tools_note: T5 is reserved for saw/notch and cannot be overridden by the tool library.
_comment_wtype_map: V6 WType drives the Mecal .wrk macro called in the output:
WType=L     →  STD_SLOT    (oblong slot  — PAR1=Z start, PAR2=length, PAR3=width)
WType=R     →  STD_POCKET  (rect pocket  — PAR1=Z start, PAR2=width, PAR3=height, PAR4=corner R, PAR5=rotation, PAR6=mode)
WType=Notch →  STD_NOTCH   (blade notch at head/tail — PAR1=position from end, PAR2=Z face pos, PAR3=notch width, PAR4=orientation, PAR5=head/tail)
The macro name must match a .wrk file present in the Mecal standard library.
_comment_std_hole: PAR1 (L1) = Starting Z-Point  — WHeight + hole_par1_offset  (signed; negative WHeight is preserved)
Per-WSide override: set par1_formula='abs_wheight + offset' in profiles.json for legacy positive-only WHeight
_comment_std_notch: PAR1 (L1) = Position from end — WSawPlaneX (head) or CLength-WSawPlaneX (tail)
PAR4 (L4) = Orientation       — fixed 1 (horizontal; use 3 for vertical)
Face/Position are always zero — notch macro positions itself from bar end.
_comment_std_drill: STD_DRILL.wrk — Drill operation (G105). Uses tool-table diameter — no diameter PAR.
PAR1 (L1) = Starting Z-Point — depth of the drill.
Not currently generated by the preprocessor (no matching V6 WType).
_comment_other_wrk: Other macros available in the Mecal standard library (not yet generated):
STD_KEYHOLE    G120  — Keyhole (PAR1=Z start, PAR2=big Ø, PAR3=small Ø, PAR4=length, PAR5=rotation)
STD_TAP        G130  — Tapping (PAR1=total depth, PAR2=start depth, PAR3=pitch)
STD_CUT        G411  — Saw cut (PAR1..PAR13 for angle, lead-in, offset, etc.)
STD_BLADE      G500  — Blade notch simplified variant
_comment_faces: Face/side mapping from V6 WSide number to Camquix Face parameters.
WSide 1-6 are the standard six faces of an aluminium bar.
WSide 7 is a profile-specific angled face (e.g. 55-degree sill drainage face).
Adjust angle_a for WSide 7 to match your sill profile geometry.

7._comment: Angled sill face (55-degree drainage). Adjust angle_a to match your sill profile.
